research_question: Which genuinely new information source is worth acquiring next for a zero-label strict-PIT audit, without reopening consumed Understat/API-Football feature families?

required_gate.minimum_prior_history: enough completed same-league history to form latest8/min3 snapshots at the start of the 2020 target season

desired_new_information: event-level pass start/end XY and progression/line-breaking structure
carry/possession-chain structure not reducible to shot profile
pass-network topology derived only from prior completed matches

providers.candidate_product: Opta F24 XY / granular football event archive
publicly_supported_claims: proprietary archive spans about 35 years across hundreds of leagues and includes Opta F24 xy data
football event data is collected in real time with a consistent QA methodology
deep historical data is available, but exact requested competition/season field completeness requires provider confirmation
sample_request: Big5 fixture/event inventory for 2019-20 through 2022-23 sufficient to reconstruct 2020-2022 targets
F24 event schema with pass start/end XY, carries/duels/pressure-like event context if licensed
per league-season fixture counts and missing-field counts
provider export/version identity and correction/backfill policy

publicly_supported_claims: standard event data records roughly 3400 events per match and includes event-level pressure plus pass footedness/height
360 adds surrounding player locations and line-breaking/space/defender context
free public Big5 release provides all 1826 matches only for 2015/16; this does not cover the 2020-2022 development cohort
sample_request: standard event pressure/pass/carry fields before considering 360
per league-season missingness and data-spec/version identity
confirmation that all matches in each supplied league-season use a consistent collection spec

publicly_supported_claims: Events Pack provides event data with precise event location
Stats Pack exposes more than 150 match/season metrics
public product page does not establish exact historical Big5 season coverage or row-level PIT/version provenance
tracking coverage spans many competitions with some multi-season archives going back as far as 2018/19
Game Intelligence combines tracking and event data for pressure, off-ball movement and passing options
public Game Intelligence material shows a Big5 2021-2026 horizon, which is too late to certify the full frozen 2020-2022 development design without a special historical export

providers.candidate_product: Football API historical stats / Expected Lineups / Pressure Index
publicly_supported_claims: provider has collected football data for about 10 years, but historical depth and stat types differ by league and season and must be checked explicitly
current API exposes player/team statistics, expected lineups and a pressure index

the standard stat family overlaps previously consumed API-Football technical features, while historical availability of expected-lineup/pressure products for the required cohort is not publicly proven

public_data_decision.statsbomb_open_data: FAIL_REQUIRED_HORIZON: complete Big5 public release is 2015/16 only

priority_order: Stats Perform Opta F24 XY vendor sample
Hudl Statsbomb standard Event Data vendor sample
Hudl Wyscout Events Pack vendor sample
SkillCorner only for a later-horizon lane unless earlier Big5 backfill is proven

required_before_any_model_fit: obtain a small provider sample or coverage manifest without opening 2023/1335 labels
freeze provider/source identity, schema and file SHA
map fixture identities to the frozen Big5 2020-2022 target inventory
run zero-label per-field and bilateral feature coverage audit
run semantic de-dup against all consumed families
only if source coverage >=0.98 and mechanism is materially independent, preregister exactly one candidate
next_mechanical_step.reason_for_stop: Current authorization permits source feasibility/audit but does not authorize purchasing a provider, accepting commercial terms, or creating/storing provider secrets.
